messages:
toni hall: Heads-up: Product wants a clear deprecation playbook for v1 -> v2 that covers docs, customer comms, and SDK compatibility shims. Goal: one-page migration checklist + FAQs. Can someone take lead on the public-facing copy?
devin rao: I can draft the public-facing notice and the FAQ. Will aim for short bullets and an "if you see X" troubleshooting section.
yasmin ahmed: I'll own the snippets audit. Plan: scan repo for `models.createCompletion` and `client.completions` usages and open PRs to replace with `responses.create` patterns. Also compile a diff summary for reviewers.
toni hall: Great. Include a small note about streaming: make sure streaming snippets show the new chunk/framing API.
yasmin ahmed: Yep. Also adding an automated lint rule that flags legacy completion calls in the docs build.
aria gomez: Ops note: Dedicated customers can request a v1 route pin for up to 30 days; add the contact ops+dedicated@redwood.ai. Also we should document the embed model dimension change: redwood-embed-v1=1536 -> redwood-embed-v2=2048 and include a migration CLI example.
devin rao: Draft FAQ items: how long shim will exist (90 days), how to enable shim (`new RedwoodClient({legacyCompat: true})`), how to remove it, and embed dim checks.
yasmin ahmed: Snippet sample for CLI: ```bash
redwood-migrate index --from redwood-embed-v1 --to redwood-embed-v2 --dry-run --report out.json
# out.json contains mapping plan and affected indices
```
toni hall: Add a short rollback section: restore previous client version, reapply old snippets, and contact support. Also add a "how to validate" section with curl smoke tests and unit test expectations.
aria gomez: Ops-bot: tenancy-service: pinned-route enabled for tenant corp-123 until 2026-06-15 (manual approval required).
devin rao: For the migration checklist top-of-guide: 1) backup indices, 2) run index migration with --dry-run, 3) run recall-check (top1/top5), 4) update CI snapshots, 5) remove shim after verification.
yasmin ahmed: Will open PRs for JS/TS, Python, Ruby snippets. Tagging @devs for quick reviews and adding a preview link in PR.
toni hall: Perfect. Please include estimated ETA for each PR in the PR description so release managers can coordinate the public announcement.
devin rao: I'll also draft short internal email for enterprise customers with pinned v1 explaining timeline (30/60/90) and how to request assistance.
yasmin ahmed: PRs opened: #4210 (snippets/js-ts), #4211 (snippets/python), #4212 (snippets/ruby). docs-ci flagged one old Go sample; fixing now.
toni hall: Thanks everyone. Once PR previews look good, we'll schedule the banner and changelog flip. Ping here when merged.
